duration.text: The Finance at Shandong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Academic transcript of high school5. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English.6. Certificate of No criminal record7. Scanned copies of the financial guatrantee materials8. Foreigner physical examiantion form Additional supplementary materials required by Shandong University updated time: 2025-03-10

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent.2. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport3. With a good health and the age above 18.
